_comment: Security tuning: raids, lockdown, anti-nuke, new accounts. See DECISIONS.md, Decisions 16-19.
Every automatic action here is a timeout, a pause, or a role strip. Never a kick or a ban
(Decision 14). The model never reads this file (Decision 12).
Johnny's join counter: `joins` joins inside `windowSeconds` is a raid. Discord's own raid
flag also triggers it when listenToDiscordFlag is true; that path times out the joins from
the last discordFlagLookbackSeconds. Joiners who arrive up to windowSeconds after the
trigger are timed out too. pauseMinutes is how long invites and DMs stay paused (Discord
maximum: 1440). Needs Server Members Intent in the Developer Portal.
/lockdown on pauses invites and DMs for pauseMinutes (Discord maximum: 1440, after which
Discord lifts the pause by itself) and raises the verification level. It never edits a
channel permission (Decision 17). Levels: Low, Medium, High, VeryHigh (verified phone).
`threshold` watched actions by one executor inside `windowSeconds` strips that executor's
roles. The server owner and Johnny are exempt. Actions are AuditLogEvent names.
Needs no portal switch: the GuildModeration intent is not privileged.

newAccount._comment: A join from an account younger than `days` posts one line to the mod log. No action (Decision 19).
